name: proto-service-registered-only
description: A service hand code only registers is cut at its registration: the call of the registration function and the conversion of the server to the server interface bind nothing, so the service's consumers, the client interface, its constructor and the server interface, are unreferenced, the RPC's client method is unreferenced, and the handler is a dead implementer.
pending: bindings.9: deadset-go reads a registration form as binding nothing (GO5).
